Exercise normal precaution

in **Anguilla**.

Anguilla is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Anguilla regularly experiences hurricanes. Review our information on [Weather and Natural Disasters](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/anguilla.html#weather "Weather and Natural Disasters in Anguilla") in Anguilla.
  * Review our [Travel Guidance for Anguilla](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/anguilla.html#requirements "Anguilla International Travel Information") to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
